name: Hide Pause Menu
description: Adds a button to the pause menu to hide it.

issues.info: If you find any bugs, please report them on GitHub.

mod_disabled.name: Disable Mod
mod_disabled.description: Disables the mod without restarting the game.

hide_button_pos.name: Button Position
hide_button_pos.description:
Position of the hide button inside the pause menu.
Setting this to 'Off' disables the button, but keybinds can still be used to hide/show the pause menu.

end_level_layer_button.name: Hide End Level Menu
end_level_layer_button.description: Applies the mod's hide behavior to the vanilla 'Hide' button on the end level screen.

hide_pause_menu-keybind.name: Hide Pause Menu
hide_pause_menu-keybind.description: Keybind to hide the pause menu, if the game is not paused this will pause it. Also controls the end level menu.

hide_pause_menu_toggle-keybind.name: Toggle Hide Pause Menu
hide_pause_menu_toggle-keybind.description: Keybind to toggle the pause menu visibility. While paused, pause one more time or press this keybind to show the pause menu. Not persistent if you change level.

auto-hide-settings.name: Auto hide settings
auto-hide-settings.description: These settings control what elements are hidden when the menu is hidden.

hide_info_label.name: Hide Info Label
hide_info_label.description: Hides the info label (shown in practice mode or via mods).

hide_ui_layer.name: Hide UI Layer
hide_ui_layer.description:
Hides the entire UI layer.
Includes practice buttons, audio visualizer, and elements added by other mods (e.g. StartPos switchers).

hide_audio_visualizer.name: Hide Audio Visualizer
hide_audio_visualizer.description: Hides the SFX and background audio visualizers.

hide_floating_buttons.name: Hide Floating Buttons
hide_floating_buttons.description:
Should hide floating buttons added by other mods.
Note: this only makes them invisible, they still remain clickable. Currently does not work with the 'QOLmod' button.
